'''Tuten''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] who owned a shop on [[Hallitron-7/Legends|Hallitron-7]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], he was visited by [[Ferus Olin]], who wanted to buy a [[Transpirator/Legends|transpirator]]. Tuten gave him a transpirator, but told the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that he was forced to report anyone, including the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], who did not want to call the registration number of his ship.<ref name="LOTJR" />
